## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Schleswig-Holstein lights up on the map of Germany.
> Schleswig-Holstein | Landeshauptstadt Kiel

[dramatic] [[Schleswig-Holstein]] is the northernmost state, between the North Sea and the Baltic, on the border with Denmark. Its capital is Kiel. It has a Danish minority, with its own party in the state parliament.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Schleswig-Holstein, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> SCHLESWIG-HOLSTEIN

## On the map

{Q448}

> SCENE (question): Question card #448. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Schleswig-Holstein?]] Which state is Schleswig-Holstein?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[1]]. Number one: the very top of the map, between two seas.


{Q447}

> SCENE (question): Question card #447. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Schleswig-Holstein heißt …]] The state capital of Schleswig-Holstein is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Kiel.]] The other three are real cities in Schleswig-Holstein, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q445}

> SCENE (question): Question card #445. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Schleswig-Holstein?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Schleswig-Holstein?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[blau-weiß-rot]]. Blue, white and red.


{Q441}

> SCENE (question): Question card #441. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Schleswig-Holstein?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the state of Schleswig-Holstein?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 3]], picture three: two blue lions on gold, and a white nettle leaf on red.


## How it's run

{Q442}

> SCENE (question): Question card #442. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Schleswig-Holstein?]] Which of these is a district in Schleswig-Holstein?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Nordfriesland]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Ammerland]] is in [[Niedersachsen]], [[Mecklenburgische Seenplatte]] is in [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]], and [[Rhein-Sieg-Kreis]] is in [[Nordrhein-Westfalen]].


{Q443}

> SCENE (question): Question card #443. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Schleswig-Holstein gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in Schleswig-Holstein elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q444}

> SCENE (question): Question card #444. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Schleswig-Holstein bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] From what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Schleswig-Holstein?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q449}

> SCENE (question): Question card #449. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Schleswig-Holstein?]] What is the head of government in Schleswig-Holstein called?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q450}

> SCENE (question): Question card #450. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Schleswig-Holstein nicht?]] Which minister does Schleswig-Holstein not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q446}

> SCENE (question): Question card #446. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Landesbeauftragten

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Schleswig-Holstein über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information about political topics in Schleswig-Holstein?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landesbeauftragten für politische Bildung]], the state's office for civic education. In most states it's called a Landeszentrale; here it has its own name. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Kiel, blau-weiß-rot, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Kiel]]. [[blau-weiß-rot]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
